description: Use when you or the user must choose a tool, API or provider for a task (send email, take payments, host a database…): send the task in a few plain words ('send an invoice') with filters if they matter. Returns the products our agent drove for it, ranked by how far an agent got on its own (sign-up, key, the work, paying), each with what happened and its sign-up, docs and MCP links. Read-only, no key needed; 5 by default, up to 25; a product by name: search_tools.

access.description: signup_without_human: only products our agent signed up for and got into without a person (no browser login by a person)

brief.description: true (the default): each product with its next steps, under 8 KB for five; false: every field, with can_do, checks, connect, pay_rails and cite

capability.description: A capability of the shared vocabulary instead of task: its id (e.g. from GET /api/capabilities) or its name, e.g. 'Send a transactional email'

category.description: Only this category: an id or name from list_categories (e.g. 'invoicing')

limit.description: How many products to return, 1 to 25 (default 5)

min_level.description: Only products at this agent level or higher: 0 Read-only, 1 Needs a person, 2 Gets in, 3 Does the work, 4 Runs on its own, 5 Autonomous

pays_with.description: only products that take this way to pay: x402 or mpp (agent-native rails our drive met or the product documents) or card (a card checkout); a comma list takes any one, e.g. x402,mpp

self_signup.description: true: only products our agent signed up for and got a key on its own, without a person

surface.description: only products that offer this way for an agent to work them: api, mcp (an MCP server), cli or sdk; a comma list wants every one, e.g. mcp,cli

task.description: The task in plain words, e.g. 'send an invoice' or 'create a contact'. Send this or capability

name: choose_provider_for_task
title: Choose a provider
